changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
• Plex plays smoothly, like the Plex app, including Resume
• Live TV and Plex right on the Home menu; Main Apps moved to Support
• Favorites in the TV Guide
• Volume up to 150%
• Playback stats in the Plex player
• Many fixes
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.9: Plex now streams smoothly at full quality, like the Plex app, and Resume picks up without buffering. Live TV and Plex have their own cards on the Home menu (Main Apps is now in Support), the TV Guide has your Favorites first, volume goes up to 150%, and the Plex player has a Playback stats screen. Plus Continue Watching and many other fixes.
